native_history_cancellation.deployment_limit: The parent exit hook does not run for default SIGTERM/SIGINT or SIGKILL. If only the parent is abruptly terminated during a native SQLite call, the orphan child may continue until that call completes before its disconnect handler runs. Whole-container/process-group termination avoids this; a host supervisor should terminate the process group. This is distinct from request deadline and HistoryReader.close cancellation, which actively SIGKILL the child.
